title: Direct-product rigidity and factor reconstruction for monoids with zero
summary: We study direct products of monoids with zero and give a criterion under which their factors can be recovered from the multiplicative structure alone. While classical decomposition theory encodes direct products through factor congruences, central elements, and refinement properties, we give a concrete multiplicative reconstruction mechanism.
